Game Overview

In HOOPS the Game, the core idea is straightforward: precision and timing are your best allies in HOOPS. Maneuver skillfully as you toss your basketball from hoop to hoop, aiming for direct shots to rack up bonus points. Collect coins along the way to unlock stylish customizations for your ball. Can you master the ultimate high score challenge?
